# PR #1 Review: First-MCP Server Client - Weather Forecast

- **Pull request:** [Prabukmca/agentic-ai-projects#1](https://github.com/Prabukmca/agentic-ai-projects/pull/1)
- **Reviewed:** 2026-10-20 14:45:22 (+05:30)
- **Review scope:** PR diff
- **Validation:** Tests and CI were not run as part of this review.

## Findings

| Severity | Location | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| High | [weather_service.py:205](https://github.com/Prabukmca/agentic-ai-projects/blob/weather-mcp-server/MCP/MCP_Servers/weather-mcp-server/weather_service.py#L205) | The forecast response is truncated to `days * 2` entries. OpenWeather provides forecast entries every three hours, so the default three-day forecast returns only about 18 hours of data. |
| High | [weather_service.py:235](https://github.com/Prabukmca/agentic-ai-projects/blob/weather-mcp-server/MCP/MCP_Servers/weather-mcp-server/weather_service.py#L235) | If no evening slots are found, the code labels the first two forecast entries as the evening forecast. This can report rain likelihood for the wrong time of day. The timestamps also need to be interpreted in India’s local timezone. |
| Medium | [server.py:26](https://github.com/Prabukmca/agentic-ai-projects/blob/weather-mcp-server/MCP/MCP_Servers/weather-mcp-server/server.py#L26) | The MCP tools require `city`, so a pincode-only request—although supported by the client and documented—can fail tool argument validation. |
| Medium | [client.py:41](https://github.com/Prabukmca/agentic-ai-projects/blob/weather-mcp-server/MCP/MCP-Clients/weather-mcp-client/client.py#L41) | A multi-word city without a comma, such as “New Delhi,” is split into city “New” and state “Delhi,” so the lookup can use the wrong location. |
